appDescription.message: Custom background layers, changeset comment suggestions, and Overture building outlines for iD.

overtureEnable.message: Show Overture building controls in iD

overtureEnableHelp.message: Enable them when you want to inspect and add buildings. This choice is saved automatically.

overtureDescription.message:
This feature lets you load the building layer from Overture.
Once enabled, at zoom 18 or higher press Load area to load the buildings in the visible area. Select an outline and press A or Add (A).
Check each building before saving: generated outlines can be inaccurate. Compare them with imagery and OSM data, and correct their shape and position when needed. If you move the map, press the button again to load the visible area.

backgroundDescription.message:
This feature lets you save additional custom backgrounds beyond the one provided by iD.
Add backgrounds here with a name and a URL template. In iD open Background settings (layers icon), then Edit custom background (three dots). Choose a saved layer in the panel to display it on the map.
Important: make sure the backgrounds you use are permitted for OpenStreetMap mapping!

commentDescription.message:
This feature suggests a comment for your changesets when you are unsure what to write. It analyzes your edits and proposes a description of the main changes.
When saving in iD, press Suggest to generate a comment based on your edits and the current area. Review and correct it before uploading, or replace it if you find it unsuitable.

For suggestions or feedback, contact me on OpenStreetMap.

commentsInEnglishHelp.message: Always write suggested comments in English, regardless of the browser language.
